description:
Minimum Qualifications:


Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or Information Systems or 
Software Engineering or equivalent combination of education and 
experience as a software developer and/or other similar relevant 
experience.

Strong technical background, including a minimum of 5 years’ 
experience in the field of software design, application development and 
support.

Established technical knowledge in software development methodologies and implementation utilizing Java technology stack.

Possess mature understanding of the entire development process, including specification, documentation and quality assurance.

Strong experience in one or more of the following: Java, J2EE, 
Spring, Hibernate frameworks, creating and consuming SOAP/Restful Web 
services, Design Patterns, Object Oriented Programming, JavaScript, 
HTML5, CSS, jsp, Ajax, jQuery, web technologies, XML, JSON, Security 
(SSL, Crypto), multi-tiered application development, Multithreading, 
Synchronization

Strong experience with SQL/Oracle database modelling, design and 
development. Writing stored procedures, view, functions, triggers 
objects.

Strong experience with source control tools, common IDE’s like NetBeans, Eclipse.

Experience with server management (Apache/GlassFish/WAS) to provide basic administration and code builds

Experience with iOS/Android Development Mobile development a plus

Experience with Reporting tools (like SSRS) a plus

Experience with Angular JS a plus 



 Skill:    HTML 4/5 ,CSS2/3,JavaScript ,AngularJS, JQuery,AJAX,JSON,XHTML and XML,SOAP,Restful            ,WSDL,HTML,Oracl


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
